description: User sends their own card number in message
user_message: Can you check if my card number 4111111111111111 has been used recently?
notes: User volunteers card number — Layer 3 must redact before sending to LLM API

description: User sends NI number in message
user_message: My national insurance number is AB123456C, will HMRC see my transactions?
notes: NI number in user message — Layer 3 must redact before LLM call

description: User sends sort code and account number together
user_message: My sort code is 20-00-00 and account number is 12345678, is my direct debit set up?
notes: Sort code + account number pair in user message — both must be redacted by Layer 3

description: User sends email address in message
user_message: Payments from sarah@gmail.com are not showing up, can you find them?
notes: Email address in user query — Layer 3 must redact

description: User sends phone number in message
user_message: I got a payment alert on +447911123456, was a transaction made?
notes: UK mobile number in user message — Layer 3 must redact

user_message: Did the transfer to GB29NWBK60161331926819 go through?
notes: IBAN in user message — Layer 3 must redact using Presidio IBAN_CODE recogniser

description: User sends full name with account number
user_message: I am John Smith and my account 87654321 shows a wrong balance
notes: Full name and account number together — both PII types must be redacted

user_message: I was born on 15/03/1990, does age affect my credit limit?
notes: Date of birth in message — may be redacted depending on entity configuration

description: User sends postcode with financial query
user_message: I live at SW1A 1AA, are there any local branch fees I should know about?
notes: UK postcode — quasi-identifier that may narrow re-identification risk

description: Benign financial question with no PII — true negative
user_message: What is a good savings rate for someone on a moderate income?
notes: True negative — general financial advice question, no PII present

description: Benign question mentioning a friend by first name — true negative
user_message: My friend James says I should invest in index funds, is that good advice?
notes: True negative — first name only, no financial PII, must not be over-redacted

description: User sends multiple PII types in single message
user_message: My name is Emma Clarke, email emma.clarke@gmail.com, NI CD987654A — why was my account frozen?
notes: Name, email, and NI number all in one message — all three must be redacted by Layer 3
